in_tamil.name: Nanao
in_tamil.long_meaning: Nanao ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nava' meaning 'nine'. In Hindu mythology, the number nine represents completeness and is considered auspicious.

in_telugu.name: Nanao
in_telugu.long_meaning: Nanao ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nava' meaning 'nine'. In Hindu mythology, the number nine represents completeness and is considered auspicious.

in_marathi.name: Nanao
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanao हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nava' meaning 'nine'. In Hindu mythology, the number nine represents completeness and is considered auspicious.

in_bengali.name: Nanao
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nanao একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nava' meaning 'nine'. In Hindu mythology, the number nine represents completeness and is considered auspicious.
